verification.openAi: Published GPTBot and OAI-SearchBot IPv4 prefixes
verification.bing: Reverse DNS under search.msn.com followed by forward confirmation of the original IP
verification.google: Reverse DNS under googlebot.com followed by forward confirmation of the original IP
verification.perplexity: Published PerplexityBot and Perplexity-User IPv4 prefixes

attributionEvidence.burstRule: At least 8 requests across at least 5 landing pages within 60 seconds for the same User-Agent, source, and campaign

evidenceBoundary: Verified crawler access proves only the stated request. GPTBot is a training crawler. Discovery-file access is not content ingestion. IndexNow receipt, attributed requests, crawler access, and public files do not prove search indexing, AI retrieval, citation, or non-brand recommendation. No prompt was sent to Doubao for this checkpoint.
